name: sample-orders-emailed-as-list
description: input.csv is read (and deleted), mapped to a list of maps with numeric pricePerUnit/units/totalPrice, and sent as a text email from mail.from to mail.to with mail.subject. The Mule IT reads the newest message over IMAP and asserts its body (trimmed) equals src/main/resources/email.txt.

source.reference: sending-a-csv-file-through-email-using-smtp/src/test/java/org/mule/examples/SendingACsvFileThroughEmailUsingSmtpIT.java#sendCSVFile (assertEquals(TEST_EMAIL_BODY = src/main/resources/email.txt, message.trim()); mail.subject 'Mule flow completed!' set in init()); input src/main/resources/input.csv

expected.body: [{name=aaa, orderId=1, pricePerUnit=10, units=2, totalPrice=20}, {name=bbb, orderId=2, pricePerUnit=5, units=4.15, totalPrice=20.75}]
